findings.title: Gaza Strip and West Bank: Situation Update and Humanitarian Response
findings.affected_population_system: UNICEF's November 27 winterization report documents distribution of 65 incubators to 10 neonatal intensive care sites and completed rapid winterization works at Al-Helou Hospital. Israeli authorities indicated approval for most of UNICEF's November 22 priority winter list, including 11 pumps, 72 generators, 54,210 litres of engine oil, desalination plant spare parts and three water trucks; formal system approval for entry remains pending. This is a report of cumulative assistance and conditional access, not confirmation that the pending supplies have entered or that hospital capacity has increased by a specific bed count.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: UNICEF has distributed 65 new incubators to 10 Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) sites
findings.source_type: Primary official humanitarian agency operational situation report

bounded_discovery_context.method: Targeted humanitarian search; official UNICEF PDF opened, pages 1 and 3 visually inspected; compared with 31 authenticated hourly heartbeat files from November 27 00:44 through November 28 06:44.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Newly recovered operational report and specific neonatal equipment distribution and conditional WASH equipment access absent from reviewed findings. Broader flood and sewage warnings already recorded and are not new incidents.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Document dated November 27; exact publication and individual delivery dates unknown. Newly discovered during interval, not necessarily first published then. No production collector comparison.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary recall only; production remains authoritative.
